A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–K. No material gaps limit the comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original layer-localization, fine-tuning, text-editing, and toxicity-prevention experiments, together with appendix ablations and additional analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the appendix studies of training size, text style, emotional expression, and longer texts.

M1.justification: The activation-patching procedure, localized layers, LoRA strategy, and editing applications are unchanged, as is Algorithm 1. Correcting the abstract's architecture examples does not change the method or evaluated models.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MARIO-LAION training data, SimpleBench and CreativeBench evaluations, and toxicity, emotional-expression, text-style, and longer-text scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain all-layer LoRA, P2P/P2P*, Negative Prompt, Safe Diffusion/Safe Diffusion*, and Prompt Swap. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The benchmark splits, evaluated models, metrics, patching timesteps, and training settings are unchanged. Appendix D retains the same training-size sweep, 12,000 steps, batch size 512, and learning rate.

E4.justification: The same analyses examine layer specialization, patching timesteps, alternative layer sets, training sizes, injected-layer counts, emotional preservation, text style, and longer-text editing. None is added, removed, or revised.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains its execution-time uncertainty reporting. Appendix G retains ten generations per prompt with paired random seeds, and Figure 10 retains the same error bars.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted curves, rankings, and qualitative examples are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 retains localized parameter fractions of 0.61%, 0.21%, and 0.23% for SDXL, DeepFloyd IF, and SD3.

T1.justification: The attention equations and mathematical descriptions of patching and layer selection are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The claims of localization below 1% of parameters, applicability across architectures, and benefits for fine-tuning, editing, and toxicity prevention are retained. The abstract's corrected architecture examples do not change these contributions or their substantive scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning layer specialization, overfitting, background and emotional preservation, distributed text-style control, and dependence on the base model's text-generation quality remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The implementation descriptions, hyperparameters, prompt templates, baseline adaptations, pseudocode, and project-page access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning against prior localization, editing, and fine-tuning research are unchanged. Several citations receive punctuation or parenthetical-format corrections only.

P1.justification: The abstract moves DeepFloyd IF from the transformer-based examples to the U-Net examples and drops LDM from that illustrative list. Citation formatting and figure/appendix references receive small edits; sections and appendices remain in the same order.

P2.justification: The acknowledgments heading is enlarged, some text reflows, and Figure 3's caption changes its reference from Appendix E to Section E. Figure artwork, plotted curves, image examples, table structures, and their placement are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the abstract's classification of DeepFloyd IF, resolving its inconsistency with the U-Net description already present in Section 4.1. Citation cleanup also modestly improves presentation. The methods and empirical evidence, including the appendices, remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
